Alaka
or allaTa son of Jayānaka, of Kashmir; first half of the 12th Cent. A. D.
--C. Viṣamapadoddyta on Ratnākara's Haravijaya. Pt.. in the edn. of the Haravijaya in K.

; p. 176, q. Kuntaka's Vakroktijīvita on the 3 mārgas.
--C. on Ruyyaka's Alaṁkārasarvasva; ref. to by Ratnakaṇṭha in his C. on the Kāvyaprakāśa. Peters. II. p. 17. Stein (Intro. p.. 24-26) distinguishes this Alaka from the collaborator of Mammaṭa whom he calls only Allaṭa. Peterson (II. p.. 14-15) identifies the two.
--Kāvyaprakāśa-joint author from the Parikara section according to some, but from even earlier portions according to Arjunavarman on Amaruśataka, 30, 72.

Alakadatta
poet. foremost Brāhmaṇa, Sāndhivigrahika, teacher of Kalyāṇa, i. e. [Page396-a. Kalhaṇa, the a. of the Rājataraṅgiṇī. See Maṅkhuka, Śrīkaṇṭhacarita,

Alakāpurīmāhātmya
from Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa; on the greatness of Karandai or Karuttaṭṭānguḍi, a suburb of Tanjore. Burnell 190b.

Alakṣmīśānti
or alakSmIharakumbhAbhiSekavidhi dh. from Yāmala. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 6.

Alakṣyastotra
in 12 stanzas by Siddheśvara Śarman. RASB.

Alagaddūpamasutta
Bud. Pāli. from Majjhimanikāya. Ed.. an. French transl. in La Pensee bouddhique Bulletin des Amis du Bouddhisme, Paris, IV. iv. (

Alaguptā_Nāma_Sādhana
Bud. Cordier II. p. 187. Sādhanamālā,
. GOS. XLI. Intro. p. cx. gives its a. a. Prajñāpālita.

Alaṅkāra
alaṁk. a mere list of Alaṁkāras.

Alaṅkāra
shortened to Laṅkaka, third son of Viśvāvarta, son of Manmatha; elder brother of Maṅkha, the minister of Jayasiṁha of Kashmir; a great grammarian an. Sāndhivigrahika of king Sussala of Kashmir (died 1128 A. D.); flourished also during Sussala's son Jayasiṁha's time (1129-50 A. D.).
See Śrīkaṇṭhacarita of Maṅkha,

Alaṅkāra
Bud. fuller name is Vārttikālaṁkāra. Prajñākaragupta's Bhāṣya in prose [Page396-b] an. verse on Dharmakīrti's Pramāṇavārttika.

Alaṅkāra
a form of literary composition among the Buddhists, not a mahāśāstra, but a short summary of the salient features of the system. See Wint., HIL. II. p. 630. Tucci, JASB(NS) XXVI (1930) p. 127.
Subandhu (Vāsavadattā, Bauddhasangatim iva alaṁkāra-bhūṣitām) refers to this type of work.
E. g. Abhisamayālaṁkāra, Sūtrālaṁkāra etc.
. This may be Pramāṇavārttika of Dharmakīrti with Prajñākaragupta's C. called Vārttikālaṁkāra or Alaṁkāra.

Alaṅkāra
Bud. mentioned in a list of works in a. Insc. of 1442 a. Pagan. See Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma, p. 108.

Alaṅkāra
śaiva. Upāgama in Sahasrāgama. See list in Kāmika.

Alaṅkāraṭīkā
See Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma p. 108. nos. 242. 261.

Alaṅkāra_(?)
by Leśabhatilaka (?) D. p. 39. Gough p. 99 (inc.). According to the Jinaratnakośa of H. D. Velankar, this is really Hemacandra's Dvyāśrayakāvya with Abhayatilaka's C.

Alaṅkārakarṇābharaṇa
by Viśveśvara of Almora.
Pt.. Bombay.

Alaṅkārakalaśa
Bud.
--Śrīvajramālāmahāyoga tantraṭīkāgambhīrārtha dīpikā. Cordier II. p. 134.

Alaṅkārakāra
Prajñākaragupta (a of the Vartikālaṁkāra on Dharmakīrti's Pramāṇavārttika). [Page397-a.
Rahula Sankrityayana says that in Tibet, the a. is known also a. Alaṁkāra Paṇḍita.
One an. a half Kārikās of Alaṁkārakāra are q. in Rāmakaṇṭha's C. on the Nareśvaraparīkṣā of Sadyojyotis, Kas. Texts 45, p.. 52, 53.

Alaṅkārakārikā
alaṁk. (not known if this is Kuvalayānandakārikā or another work). Ānandāśrama 576. Bikaner 3546 (by son of Janārdana).
(The last illustrative verse here is found in the Kuvalayānanda). D. p. 85.

Alaṅkārakulapradīpa
alaṁk. by Viśveśvara, son of Lakṣmīdhara. Alwar 1033.

Alaṅkārakaumudī
alaṁk. Mysore I. p. 295 (inc.). (from Utprekṣā to Aprastutapraśaṁsā).

Alaṅkārakaumudī
alaṁk. by Vallabha Bhaṭṭa (of recent times). Pt.. Grantharatnamālā

Alaṅkārakaumudīvyākhyā
alaṁk. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 6.

Alaṅkārakaustubha
alaṁk. an. C. by Kalyāṇa Subrahmaṇya of Perūr family; grandson of Gopāla an. son of Subrahmaṇya; patronised by (Bāla) Rāma Varman, king of Travancore (1758-98), who is eulogised in the work; deals only with Arthālaṅkāras.
. Śg. II. p. 80. no. 125. Extr. p. 221. [Page397-b]

Alaṅkārakaustubha
alaṁk. by Paramānandadāsa alias Kavikarṇapūra Gosvāmin.

.
--C. a.. Sūcīpattra 14.
--C. by Sārvabhauma, pupil of a Cakravarttin.

Alaṅkārakaustubha
an. C. by Viśveśvara, son of Lakṣmīdhara. B.

. Peters. V. p. 259 (no. 405). PUL. II. p. 196 (2 mss.). Stein 58 (2 mss.).
--C. by Karṇapūra. PUL. II. p. 196.
Pt.. K.

Alaṅkārakaustubha
by Veṅkaṭācārya, son of Aṇṇayārya of Surapuram an. of the Tirumala Bukkapaṭṭaṇam Śrīśaila family; also called Kirīṭi Veṅkaṭācārya; patronised by Veṅkaṭa, son of Pāmi Nāyaka; (died in 1802 A. D.). Adyar

.
See also V. Raghavan, J. Andhra His. Res. Soc. XIII. i. p.. 17 an. 20-22.

Alaṅkārakramamālā
an. C. alaṁk. by Dāmodara Bhaṭṭa Harṣe.

Alaṅkāragrantha
alaṁk. different unidentified works. Adyar II. p. 33a (2 mss.).
(notes from Citramīmāṁsā etc.). 5260 (a list of 120 Alaṁkāras). 5261 (cites Camatkāracandrikā, Āndhraśrīdhara, Sāhityacandrodaya an. Sāhityaratnākara). 7911. Jainagranthāvalī p. 315.
(uses the Pratāparudrīya). Pallippurattu Mana 41. Pattan I. p.. 61 (inc.). 197. Śg.
A (inc.). Does this refer to the next ?

Alaṅkāracandrikā
alaṁk. name of C. by Vaidyanātha Pāyaguṇḍa on the Kuvalayānanda.

Alaṅkāracandrikā
or Kāvyacandrikā. alaṁk. by Nyāyavāgiśa Śarman, son of Vidyānidhi, with a C. Alaṁkāramañjūṣā, by Rāmacandra Śarman.
Pt.. Veṅk. Press, Bombay, 1912.

Alaṅkāracandrikā
saṅgīta. by Nārāyaṇadeva; q. by him in his Saṅgīta Nārāyaṇa; deals with the subject of music alaṁkāras an. not rhetoric.
See ABORI. XVI. p.. 128-130.

Alaṅkāracandrodaya
alaṁk. (6 chs.) by Veṇīdatta Śarman Tarkavāgiśabhaṭṭācārya, son of Vīreśvara Śrīvara of the Nāgacchatradhara family.

Alaṅkāracintāmaṇi
alaṁk. by Ajitasenācārya, a Jain Guru of the Śāntīśvara temple a. Baṅgavāḍi. Arrah I. A. p. 22 (a. given a. Jinasenācārya, probably wrong). Lakṣmīsena p. 17.
. Mysore I. p. 295 (2 mss.). Rice 304. Śravaṇabelgola 147. 325. Svadi 36 (a..). Trav.

. [Page399-a.
D., Skt. Poe. I. p.. 317. 363, Alaṁkāracintāmaṇi by Śāntarāja,

, Śāntarāja is the scribe of the Alaṁk. cint. of Ajitasena.
Pt.. in the Kāvyāmbudhi, 1893-94.
--C. Mysore I. p. 295. Mentions that Ajitasena wrote the work in the Śāntīśvara temple a. Baṅgavāḍipura.

Alaṅkāracintāmaṇi
by Ahobala Paṇḍita, father of Kalya Lakṣmīnarasiṁha, who mentions it in the prologue to his play Janakajānanda.
See Proceed. AIOC. XIII. Nagpur, 1961, p.. 152 ff.

Alaṅkāracintāmaṇi
alaṁk. a.. Svadi 36. Same a. the work by Ajitasenācārya ?
--by Jinasenācārya (mistake for Ajitasenācārya ?) Arrah I. A. p. 2.
--by Nemicandrācārya. Śravaṇabelgola 196.

Alaṅkāracintāmaṇi
alaṁk. by Rāmacandra Rājaguru, son of Gadādhara Rājaguru (compiler of Smṛtis). Rep.

Alaṅkāracintāmaṇi
by Śivānandagiri. Luck. Uni. p. 51.

Alaṅkāracūḍāmaṇi
alaṁk. name of Hemacandra's own gloss on his Kāvyānuśāsana sūtras.
See K. M. edn., K. A. of Hemacandra.

Alaṅkāracūḍāmaṇi
alaṁk. by RājacūḍāmaṇiDīkṣita, son of Ratnakheṭa Śrīnivāsa Dīkṣita. Mentioned by him among his works a. the end of his Kāvyadarpaṇa,

Alaṅkāratilaka
alaṁk. by Appayya Dīkṣita II. See
, Col. to Appayya III's Tantrasiddhāntadīpikā an.

of 1898-99, prologue to Appayya III's Vasumatīcitrasenīyanāṭaka. [Page399-b]
See V. Raghavan, Proceed. AIOC. X. (1940) Tirupati, p.. 176-180.
. Mysore I. p. 295. Peters. VI. p. 91 (no. 370). Extr. p. 29 (inc.). Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 53.

Alaṅkāratilaka
alaṁk. name of C. by Vāgbhaṭa II, son of Nemikumāra on his own Kāvyānuśāsana sūtras.
Pt.. K.

Alaṅkāradarpaṇa
alaṁk. a.. Mysore I. p. 296. Deals with Śabda an. Artha Alaṁkāras; breaks off in Virodhābhāsa.

Alaṅkāradarpaṇa
alaṁk. in Pkt. (134 verses). Jainagranthāvalī p. 314. Jesalmere p. 24. Montsber. Berl.

Alaṅkāradāna
dh. from the Rudrayāmala. Burnell 150a.

Alaṅkāradīpikā
alaṁk. name of C. by Āśādhara on Kuvalayānanda.

Alaṅkāradīpikā
alaṁk. by Abhinava Bhaṭṭa Bāṇa. Bikaner 3548. [Page400-a.

Alaṅkāranikaṣa
by Sudhīndrayogin. Illustrative verses are also in praise of a Sudhīndra.

Alaṅkāraniruktikā
alaṁk. a C. on Candrāloka.

Alaṅkāranirūpaṇa
alaṁk. Nabadwip 999.
This is only another name of the Candrāloka of Jayadeva.

Alaṅkāranissaya
Bud. Pāli. rhetoric. a. edn. of Saṅgharakkhita's Subodhālaṅkāra, with a C. written in 1880. See Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma, p. 95. Malalasekhara, Pāli Lit. Ceylon, p.. 199. 200.
Pt.. Rangoon, 1880.

Alaṅkārapariśiṣṭa
alaṁk. by Kṛṣṇānanda Bhaṭṭācārya. Mithilā.

Alaṅkārapariṣkāra
ny. a disquisition on the nature of the verb (Ākhyātārtha) by Viśvanātha Pañcānana, son of Vidyānivāsa.

Alaṅkārapradīpa
alaṁk. by Viśveśvara (Parvatīya). Pt.. Kasi Skt.

Alaṅkāraprabandha
by Mṛtyuñjaya. Luck. Uni. p. 63.

Alaṅkāraprabodha
(or ºparimala) alaṁk. by Amaracandra; cited by him in his Kāvyakalpalatāvṛtti. IO. i. p. 340a (p. 147. Benares edn. of 1886 by Rāma Śāstrī).

Alaṅkārabhāṣya
alaṁk. Q. by Jayaratha in his Alaṁkārasarvasvavimarśinī (p.. 35, 83. 138, 173. K. M. edn.).
See also Jagannātha, Rasagaṅgādhara, p.. 239, 365. K. M. edn.

Alaṅkārabhedanirṇaya
alaṁk. a.. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 59. [Page400-b]

Alaṅkāramakaranda
alaṁk. by Kollūri Rājaśekhara, of Peruru in Āndhra, of a family of Drāviḍas. The work q. Camatkāracandrikā an. praises a chief called Rāmeśvara of Aṇipiṇḍivaṁśa, of Mukteśvara, son of Viśveśvara an. described a. ‘Ammanna mahīmahendra’; see above under Ammaṇṇa,
. Rājaśekhara is said to have been patronised also by Peshwa Mādhava Rao, 1760-1772 A. D.

Alaṅkāramañjarī
alaṁk. cited by Ruyyaka; in his Alaṁkārasarvasva, p. 15, K.

Alaṅkāramañjarī
or arthAlaGkAramaJjarI alaṁk. by Trimalla Bhaṭṭa of Kāśī, son of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa.
, I. p. 10. Peters. IV. p. 25 (no. 661). Extr. p. 21. PUL. II. p. 196. RASB.

Alaṅkāramañjarī
alaṁk. by Sukhalāla, pupil of Gaṅgeśa an. his son Hariprasāda; follows Jayadeva's Candrāloka.

Alaṅkāramañjarī
alaṁk. by Veṇīdatta. Mithilā II. ii. 2.
Pt.. by Badrinatha Jha on the basis of the same ms., Mithila Institute of Post-Graduate Studies an. Sanskrit Learning, Darbhanga, 1961.

Alaṅkāramañjarī
alaṁk. in praise of the Telugu Zamindar Rāmacandra of Kākarlapūḍi family.

Alaṅkāramañjarī
alaṁk. by Sudhīndra, disciple an. successor of Vijayīndra (died 1623 A. D.). The illustrations seem to be in [Page401-a. praise of the teacher Vijayīndra. Burnell 57a (only Śabdālaṁkāra port) ion).

(only Śabdālaṁkāra portion).
--C. Madhudhārā by Sumatīndra, a successor of Sudhindra. Burnell 57a (only Śabdālaṁkāra portion).

Alaṅkāramañjūṣā
alaṁk. by Devaśaṅkara Purohita; glorifies the Peshwas Madhava Rao I an. his uncle Raghunātha Rao, 1761-68 A. D.

. Ujjain I. p. 43.
Pt.. Scindia Oriental Series 1.

Alaṅkāramañjūṣā
alaṁk. name of C. on Alaṁkāracandrikā or Kāvyacandrikā. See above under Alaṁk. candrikā.

Alaṅkāramaṇidarpaṇa
alaṁk. by Pradhāni Veṅkayāmātya of Mysore,
-1780 A. D. Gough p. 189. Mysore I. p.. 296 (5 mss.). 639. Rice 280.

Alaṅkāramaṇihāra
alaṁk. by Kṛṣṇabrahmatantra Parakālasvāmin. Parakala 26.
Pt.. Mysore Govt. Ori. Lib. Ser., 4 parts, 51, 58. 68. 72.

Alaṅkāramaṇḍana
alaṁk. by Maṇḍana Mantrin. Chani 3182. Jainagranthāvalī p. 314. See Intro. p. 27. Stuticaturviṁśatikā, Āgamodaya Samiti Series 51.
Pt.. Hemacandrācārya Granthāvalī, Ahmedabad, 1918.

Alaṅkāramahodadhi
an. C. alaṁk. by Maladhari Narendraprabha, pupil of Naracandra of the Harṣapurīyagaccha; composed a. the request of Vastupāla. [Page401-b]
Jainagranthāvalī p. 314 (with a.'s own C.). Arthālaṁkāravarṇana of Narendraprabha on the same page, seems only to be a part of this work. Pattan I. Intro. p.. 44-8 (with a.'s own C.).
Also ref. to in the Praśasti to Rājaśekhara's Pañcika on Nyāyakandalī, Peters. III. Extr. p. 275; Stuticaturviṁśatikā, Āgamodaya Samiti Series 51, Intro. p. 27.
Pt..

Alaṅkāramīmāṃsā
alaṁk. Q. in Yogeśvara's Vāsanābhāṣya on the Bhāgavata.

Alaṅkāramīmāṃsā
alaṁk. by Kṛṣṇasūri, son of Gopālācārya, son of Kṛṣṇārya, of the Śāntalūri family.

Alaṅkāramuktāvalī
alaṁk. by Rāmasudhī, son of Nṛsiṁha. Pt.. with C. Ratnaśobhākara of Kṛṣṇasūri, in Telugu script, Vizagapatam, 1897-8.

Alaṅkāramuktāvalī
alaṁk. by Śrīnivāsa of Tirumala Bukkapaṭṭaṇam family. Amarcinta

Alaṅkāramuktāvalī
alaṁk. by Viśveśvara (Parvatīya), son of Lakṣmīdhara. Alwar 1035.

Alaṅkāramuktāvalī
alaṁk. by Lakṣmīdhara (?) America 2410. B.

. Probably same a. the above.
See ABORI. XVIII. ii. (1937) p. 200. [Page402-a.

Alaṅkāramuktāvalī(nṛsiṃhabhūpālīya)
alaṁk. by Kṛṣṇayajvan. Adyar II. p. 33b. Adyar D.

Alaṅkāramauktikamālā
alaṁk. by Kṛṣṇa, son of Rāmārya, eulogises Satyanāthatīrtha; q. Vīranārāyaṇa. Viśvabhāratī 2311.

Alaṅkāraratnākara
alaṁk. a.. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 8.

Alaṅkāraratnākara
(Ḍuṅgarālaṁkāraratnākara) alaṁk. by Kavirāja, son of Kāntabhaṭṭa. Bikaner 3549 (d. 1624 A. D.).

Alaṅkāraratnākara
by Ḍhuṇḍhirāja (?). R. A. Sastri I. p. 27.

Alaṅkāraratnākara
alaṁk. by Yajñanārāyaṇa (eulogises Raghunātha Nāyak of Tanjore). Burnell 54a.
is the same verse saumyA guNAH etc., which is quoted in the Alaṅkāraratnākara with the preparatory note, yathA v. asmadIye nATake (

Alaṅkāraratnākara
alaṁk. by Śobhākaramitra, of Kashmir, son of minister Trayīśvara; latter part of 12th Cent. an. early part of 13th Cent.
an. Peters. I. contain also Yaśaskara's illustrative Devīstotra an. Ratnakaṇṭha's gloss). D. p. 85 (3 mss. 1 inc.). (Alaṅk. udāharaṇa). Damodar.
. Report XV. CXXVIII. (Same ms. a. in RASB.

). Stein 58. Ujjain II. p. 96 (Alaṁkāraratnodāharaṇa).
Ed.. Poona Ori.

, Poona.
The Alaṁkārasūtras from this work were illustrated by Yaśaskara with his Devistotra (Peters. I. p.. 77-81) an. the [Page402-b] whole, both the sūtras an. the stotra were commented upon by Ratnakaṇṭha.
This is the work q. by Appayya in Vṛttivārttika p. 20. Rasagaṅgādhara, p. 881, says that Appayya follows Alaṁk. ratnākara.

Alaṅkāraratnāvalī
name of C. by Bhīmasena Dīkṣita on Raghuvaṁśa. Bomb.

Alaṅkārarahasya
alaṁk. by Prabhākara. q. by him in his Rasapradīpa (Princess of Wales Sar. Bha. Texts 12. p.. 8. 9. 10. 13. 15. 20. 37. 38. 39. 40).

Alaṅkārarahasya
by Rāmanātha Vidyāvācaspati. Ref. to by him in his other works. See Our Heritage II. p. 5.

Alaṅkārarāghava
alaṁk. by Cerukūri Yajñeśvara Dīkṣita, son of Cerukūri Koṇḍu Bhaṭṭa an. brother of Tirumala Yajvan an. a nephew of Lakṣmīdhara:
A. D. Q. Rasārṇava (wrongly Śabdārṇava)sudhākara an. Sāhityacintāmaṇi. Adyar D.
. Mysore I. p. 26. III. p. 7 (a..). Oppert

Alaṅkāralakṣaṇa
alaṁk. Mysore I. p. 296. Deals with Śabda an. Artha alaṁkāras; breaks off in Ananvaya.

Alaṅkāralakṣaṇa
alaṁk. Mysore I. p. 296. Deals with Arthālaṁkāra. Q. Kaustubha an. Candrāloka.

Alaṅkāralakṣaṇāni
alaṁk. by Śambhunātha. Peters. V. p. 259 (no. 407).

Alaṅkāravādārtha
a Śābdabodha discussion; opening part discusses the first sentence of the Sāhityadarpaṇa of Viśvanātha. Hpr.

Alaṅkāravārtika
alaṁk. by Ruyyaka; q. by Jayaratha in his Vimarśinī on the Alaṁk. sarvasva. p. 71. K. M. edn.

Alaṅkāravimarśinī
name of Jayaratha's C. on Ruyyaka's Alaṁk. sarvasva. See edn. K.
. Kh. intro. p. v. Peters. IV. p. 25 (no. 657). All the entries ref. to the same ms.

Alaṅkāravyākaraṇa
(in Sūtras) by Kātyāyana.
--C. Vṛtti by Vararuci. Apocryphal. Ref. to by Nārāyaṇa in the Intro. verses in his Kāvyavṛttiratnāvalī.

Alaṅkāraśataka
alaṁk. Ānandāśrama 3059. Ujjain I. p. 43.

Alaṅkāraśāstravilāsa
alaṁk. by Rāma Subrahmaṇya (Ramasubbā) Śāstrin of Tiruviśalore.

Alaṅkāraśirobhūṣaṇa
alaṁk. by Rāyalūri Kandālayārya (patronised by the Gadwal State), son of Rāmānujācārya of the Kauśikagotra.
Adyar (by Kandāḍai Doḍḍayācārya). Adyar II. p. 33b (2 mss.). Adyar D.
(b). 5493. Mysore I. p. 296 (3 mss.). Rice 280. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 6. TA. [Page403-b] 3441 (6 Ullāsas. inc.. Trippūṇittura

(a..).
See also NCC. III. p. 146a.
Pt.. by the Gadwal State.

Alaṅkāraśiromaṇi
alaṁk. by Cakravarttin. q. by Kallola Bhaṭṭa in his C. on Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā of his grand-father Sujana. Adyar ms. LIV.

Alaṅkāraśekhara
alaṁk. by Keśava Miśra, protege of Māṇikyacandra (of Kotkaṅgra, 1563 A. D.). Adyar D.
-11, p. 9. Report XV (2 mss.). Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 57. Stein 58. Sūcīpattra 14. Trav.

Alaṅkāraśrī
Bud.
--Mahāmāyā nāma pañjikā. Cordier II. p. 102.
--Mahāmāyāsādhanamaṇḍalavidhi. ibid. p. 105.

Alaṅkārasaṅgraha
